once-after-completing-enakhra-s-lament.npc: Well, thank you, adventurer. You've just deprived me of a wonderful chance to learn from one of Zamorak's first followers.

once-after-completing-enakhra-s-lament.player: What? What about that treasure you were looking for?

once-after-completing-enakhra-s-lament.npc: You utter imbecile! Did you think I was looking for gold?
sigh* I might as well stay to study this temple. It has some interesting magical properties.

once-after-completing-enakhra-s-lament.player: Ooh, you're a mage? Can you teach me any spells?

once-after-completing-enakhra-s-lament.npc: If you really want to learn my spells, you'll have to dedicate yourself to Zamorak.

steps.npc: Then you won't be learning any of my spells.

steps.player: You're not very nice, are you?

steps.npc: What did you expect from a Zamorakian mage?
You really thought I would teach you my secrets just like that? Ha ha ha! You are a naive fool.

steps.player: That's not very nice of you.

steps.npc: I'm a mage of Zamorak, after all. What else do you expect?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-lost.npc: How are you and your defective brain doing nowadays, adventurer?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-lost.player: I've lost the amulet that Akthanakos gave me.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-lost.npc: You really are an idiot, aren't you? You dropped it in here when you left. Try not to lose it next time.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-lost.text: Lazim returns the Camulet to you.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-not-.npc: How are you and your defective brain doing nowadays, adventurer?
I'm not very nice. If you want to see who ruined all of my plans, adventurer, just look in a mirror.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-not-.player: Suit yourself. At least I got a nice amulet for my trouble.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-not-.npc: About that amulet - I might be able to improve it for you, for a fee. Have you got it with you?
Yes, it's what I thought. This amulet will run out of charges all the time, if you keep using it. For one million coins I can give it unlimited charges.

options.text: Why do you need so much money for it?

steps.player: Why do you need so much money for it?

steps.npc: Three reasons. Firstly, I'm a Zamorakian mage - we're not big on charity work. Secondly, I want the money. Finally, in case you need reminding, I hate you.

steps.text: If the player does not have at least 1 million coins:

steps.player: Right. Well, I haven't got that kind of money on me.

steps.text: If the player has at least 1 million coins:
Lazim takes your money and augments the enchantment on the Camulet.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-upgr.npc: How are you and your defective brain doing nowadays, adventurer?
I'm not very nice. If you want to see who ruined all of my plans, adventurer, just look in a mirror.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-upgr.player: Suit yourself. At least I got a nice amulet for my trouble.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-upgr.npc: And don't forget who gave it unlimited charges for you!
